eyebrow: Step 1 — Measure: the Query Store baseline
code:
SELECT rs.avg_duration / 1000.0,
  rs.avg_logical_io_reads,
  rs.count_executions
FROM sys.query_store_query AS q
JOIN sys.query_store_runtime_stats AS rs
  ON rs.plan_id = q.query_id
WHERE q.object_id =
  OBJECT_ID('dbo.usp_CustomerOrderHistory');
caption: Consumer: ~15 ms / 640 reads. Wholesale: ~28 sec / 118,000 reads.
